body:
## Summary
- require file-transfer cleanup_state artifacts to name every retained bidirectional transfer_id_hex instead of accepting any one transfer ID
- update the passing fixture cleanup artifacts to cover both directions
- add a regression test that blocks when cancel/disconnect cleanup evidence only names one direction

This only strengthens evidence/tooling fail-closed validation. It does not add real Host-backed Android/macOS file-transfer E2E evidence, does not change any README blocked/open gate to pass, and does not close Phase 0.

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_gate tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_manifest -v
- mkdir -p /tmp/vibe-screen-file-transfer-gate-check-20260909-1503 && make file-transfer-android-smoke EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/vibe-screen-file-transfer-gate-check-20260909-1503
- git diff --check

## Remaining Risk
- No GUI, MacHost, swift run, TCC, signing, Keychain, System Settings, or adb reverse flow was exercised.
- The real Android/macOS file-transfer product E2E gate remains blocked until retained Host-backed bidirectional transfer evidence exists.
- Phase 0 remains open; this PR only reduces the chance that partial cleanup evidence is over-accepted.
title: Harden file-transfer cleanup evidence gate
